hectorlee-momentum-position-advisor V0.1.0

- Initial release of a pure volume-price momentum evaluation advisor.
- Supports 12 momentum shapes (6 hold, 5 warning/reduce, 4 sell), with Pre-M11 pre-breakdown warning.
- Provides five-dimensional scoring (100-point scale) with position cost factor.
- Batch portfolio diagnostics, single-stock command-line analysis (with cost), and full-market momentum scanning supported.
- Integrates with volume-price-screener for shape confirmation.
- Designed for trend following: default is to hold unless clear momentum exhaustion or breakdown is detected.
